headline: Get Inferlupa
title: How to Get Inferlupa | Unbroken Flameruff Spirit | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Inferlupa is the Dark and Fire Breaker branch of the Emberpup line. Emberpup becomes Flameruff at level twelve after you clear Sanctum First Spark. To get Inferlupa instead of Scorchhowl, raise Flameruff to level twenty, finish the Warrior journey, and obtain the Unbroken Flameruff Spirit. Its Crossfire flame ray can pierce up to nine hits. Do you pick Inferlupa? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Inferlupa is a Dark and Fire Breaker. Flameruff evolves into it at level 20 after the Warrior journey and the Unbroken Flameruff Spirit.
joke: Fire and Dark in one wolf, so it never has a boring day.
